crossRefs.note: Then they hurried, and each man took his sack down to the ground, and each man opened his sack.

translations.web: Then they hurried, and each man took his sack down to the ground, and each man opened his sack.
translations.bsb: So each one quickly lowered his sack to the ground and opened it.
translations.kjv: Then they speedily took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.
translations.asv: Then they hasted, and took down every man his sack to the ground, and opened every man his sack.
